PLAN "12-Week General Fitness for Post-MI (Moderate-Intensity, Full Gym) with Endurance Progression to 5K Test, Compound Lifts, and Safety Protocols"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Progressive strength development within cardiac rehab limits; introduce safe compound lifts and address weakness"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Progressive aerobic base toward 5K test with safe progression"
  GOAL safety:
    name "Maintain cardiac safety: HR limits, no valsalva, no max lifts, clinician clearance for higher-intensity work"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro to full gym with compounds - phase 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 8 minutes moderate-to-vigorous (RPE 5-6)
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression with compounds - phase 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          rowing 6 minutes moderate-to-higher intensity (RPE 6)
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Stability with compound emphasis - phase 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift (light traditional or trap-bar, safe form) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 30 seconds
          calf_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progress check + form focus on compounds":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30 seconds
          back_stretch 30 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Base-building with safe squat/deadlift progressions":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
          calf_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Technique seasoning for compounds + light accessory":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 30 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Tempo control with compounds":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat or squat 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shrug 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload and reassess compound balance":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength base with keystone compounds":
        warmup:
          walking 7 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 6 minutes moderate-to-vigorous (RPE 6-7)
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Progressive overload for compounds + endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 7 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          run/walk intervals: 6 minutes total continuous if tolerable
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Compound emphasis with cardio density":
        warmup:
          walking 7 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          elliptical 6 minutes moderate-to-vigorous (RPE 6-7)
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Final reassessment with compound emphasis and 5K readiness":
        warmup:
          walking 7 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          5K time trial test protocol (medical clearance required): 5K continuous at controlled pace; record time, HR, RPE
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 60 seconds

NUTRITION PLAN OVERVIEW (aligned with program)
- Cardiac-health focus integrated with training load
- Phase-based targets:
  - Phase 1: baseline, sodium, hydration, protein, and fiber emphasis
  - Phase 2: meal timing around workouts; micronutrient focus
  - Phase 3: DASH-inspired pattern and maintenance

SAFETY AND PROTOCOLS
- All running or higher-volume cardio should be cleared by clinician; HR targets maintained near 115 bpm cap or per physician guidance
- No valsalva; monitor symptoms; adjust volume if needed
- For compounds, use safe alternatives if barbell lifts are contraindicated (trap-bar, goblet variants)
- Hydration and electrolyte balance; ensure nutrition supports endurance and strength work
- Warm-up and mobility integral before all compound lifts; core stability included as needed

END
